eps.o: The Ultimate Fighter finds out as a new roster of mixed marital arts fighters' battle it out for a six-figure UFC contract.
DC ignores the advice of his coaches to pick the next fight and it's the first bantamweight matchup of the tournament.
In the second strawweight fight, Brazilian Gigi Canuto faces Anita Karim of Pakistan for a spot in the semifinals.
Artem Belakh of Kazakhstan faces Mehemmedeli Osmanli of Azerbaijan for a spot in the semifinals.

eps.t: How Bad Do You Want It?
eps.o: Brazilian strawweights face off as Tina Black takes on Natália Alves for a spot in the semifinals.
Sean Mora and Ilimbek Akylbek Uulu battle it out for a spot in the bantamweight semifinals.
Mackenzie Stiller regroups to take on French standout Delphine Benouaich in a gritty fight.
Bantamweights Xavier Franklin and Micaias Ureña face off in the last quarterfinal fight.
